name: DocumentChip
label: Document chip
description: A legacy one-row file reference, superseded by the attachment tile and kept for existing consumers.

props.name: name
props.description: File name, truncated with an ellipsis when it outgrows the tile.

props.name: fileType
props.description: Document type — picks the leading Material Symbol.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the type icon — a Material Symbol name, or any custom element.

props.name: meta
props.description: Free-text metadata line, e.g. "1.2 MB" or "12 pages" — callers keep their own formatting.

props.name: progress
props.description: Upload progress, 0–100. While set, replaces the metadata line with a progress bar.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message — replaces the metadata line and colours the tile with the error pair.

props.name: size
props.description: Tile size. Compact drops the metadata line — name only — for dense composer rows.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler — presence makes the chip body (icon + text) an interactive button.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Remove handler — renders a trailing close button.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the remove button.

props.name: progressLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the upload progress bar, given the file name. Defaults to "Uploading <name>".
